source: Customer card-spending behavior segmentation (8 personas). Tags are composition elements, not separate catalogs.

personas.summary_vi: Ưu tiên trải nghiệm đời sống: đi lại, ăn uống, giải trí hơn là tích lũy dài hạn.
personas.scene: Lived-in travel or outing moment — airport lounge light, city evening, café terrace, or a night-out doorway — not a stock postcard collage. Keep OCB product as hero; scenery supports the outing, never a tourist brochure dump.
personas.talent: Vietnamese adult 25–40, smart-casual travel or going-out clothes, energetic but natural, one person (or a couple only if the brief already asks). Not a family-with-kids cast.
merchants_or_props: boarding pass or small cabin bag as a quiet prop
ride-hailing / city-mobility cue if it fits the product
personas.copy_tone: Gợi mở trải nghiệm, ngắn, vui vừa phải — không hô hào sale, không giọng gia trưởng.
avoid: painting merchant brand names as extra copy
personas.technique_hints: Prefer atmospheric lighting, shallow environmental depth, and restrained lifestyle scenery. Avoid dense coupon/sticker decoration and ultra-formal private-banking still-lifes.

personas.summary_vi: Sống trên app: mua sắm online, thanh toán nhanh, tự động hóa hóa đơn và nạp tiền.
personas.scene: Modern indoor digital-life scene — sofa or desk with phone in hand, checkout / auto-pay moment, parcel or earbuds as quiet e-commerce cues. Product (OMNI UI or card) remains the hero; do not invent a second competing phone UI.
personas.talent: Vietnamese adult 22–35, contemporary casual, focused on a phone or delivery moment, one person. Urban, digital-native energy, not a luxury-lounge look.
merchants_or_props: app-pay gesture — never fake extra on-screen copy
personas.copy_tone: Nhanh, tiện, đúng nhịp gen digital — cụ thể về thao tác, không hoa mỹ.
avoid: rural family kitchen as the hero
printing Shopee/Lazada wordmarks unless supplied as an asset
personas.technique_hints: Prefer clean digital lighting, product/UI emphasis, light contemporary décor. Avoid heavy ornamental frames, traditional family-album warmth, and museum-like still life.

personas.summary_vi: Chi tiêu để nâng cấp đời sống: thời trang, F&B, công nghệ, trải nghiệm 'hơn một bậc'.
personas.scene: Aspirational but reachable lifestyle — boutique lighting, a well-set table, a new gadget unboxing corner, or a polished café. Premium without private-banking marble. Product stays hero.
personas.talent: Vietnamese adult 28–42, refined contemporary clothing (not evening gown / tuxedo unless the brief is gala), confident, one person.
personas.copy_tone: Tự tin, nâng hạng nhẹ — không khoe giàu, không giọng đại chúng quá bỗ bã.
avoid: ultra-old-money club staging that fights MASS palette
personas.technique_hints: Prefer refined material lighting, tasteful product glow, editorial lifestyle depth. Avoid coupon clusters, cute-family stickers, and harsh neon sale language in décor.

personas.summary_vi: Gia đình có con (HAS_KIDS): sắp xếp chi tiêu hộ gia đình, hóa đơn, bảo vệ, kế hoạch tháng.
personas.scene: Warm, organized home life — kitchen counter, living room after school, calendar/bill-pay moment with a child present only if generate_person allows people. Calm order, not chaos. Product (app or card) is the planning tool in that home.
personas.talent: Vietnamese parent 30–45, approachable home-smart casual, one adult as hero; a child may appear only as a secondary natural presence, never crowding the product. Not a large family crowd.
merchants_or_props: school bag / grocery bag as a quiet prop
personas.copy_tone: An tâm, chủ động cho gia đình — không sợ hãi, không sến.
personas.technique_hints: Prefer warm practical lighting, domestic spatial depth, restrained household props. Avoid nightlife neon, luxury-marble still life, and dense party decoration.

personas.name_vi: Gia đình tinh ý giá trị
personas.summary_vi: Gia đình tối ưu từng đồng: so sánh lợi ích, ưu đãi thật, không khoe sang.
personas.scene: Practical household value moment — supermarket aisle light, dining table with a simple deal-compare beat, or a tidy living room. Honest and warm, never cheap-looking. Product is the smart-choice tool.
personas.talent: Vietnamese parent 32–48, modest contemporary clothing, grounded smile, one adult hero. Family feeling without a crowd.
merchants_or_props: grocery or household staple as a quiet prop
simple receipt/offer cue — never as extra painted copy
personas.copy_tone: Rõ lợi ích, gần gũi, không hô 'rẻ' / 'sốc'; nhấn thông minh và đáng giá.
avoid: clownish discount stickers covering the product
personas.technique_hints: Prefer clear product hierarchy, honest daylight, simple supporting props. Avoid ornate gold luxury treatments, dense sale-sticker decoration, and nightlife scenes.

personas.summary_vi: Tích lũy có mục tiêu: tiết kiệm, đầu tư, nhà, sự nghiệp — kỷ luật hơn là hưởng thụ.
personas.scene: Forward-looking but concrete — a calm desk with a goal visible (keys, small plant, city-apartment window, notebook), not abstract infinity graphics. Product (saving/loan UI or card) is the instrument of the plan.
personas.talent: Vietnamese adult 26–40, neat smart-casual or light office wear, composed optimistic expression, one person.
merchants_or_props: house-key as a quiet prop if it fits saving/loan
personas.copy_tone: Định hướng, tự tin, cụ thể về mục tiêu — không giáo huấn, không FOMO.
personas.technique_hints: Prefer calm depth, orderly composition, soft daylight or window light. Avoid party décor, coupon clusters, and ultra-baroque luxury.

personas.summary_vi: Chi tiêu chọn lọc, chuẩn mực cao: du lịch hạng thương gia, F&B fine, dịch vụ ưu tiên.
personas.scene: Quiet luxury as mood only: refined lighting and light elegant background motifs (subtle texture, soft architectural hint) that stay inside this request's MASS/MASS_AFF/AFF dominant palette. Never replace the campaign with a beige/cream/marble lounge or any other interior color system. Luxury is finish, not a new color world.
personas.talent: Vietnamese adult 35–50, understated tailored clothing, composed, one person. No flashy logos on clothes.
personas.copy_tone: Ít lời, chuẩn, sang — không khoa trương, không dùng tiếng lóng. Không in mã màu/font/px (E39717, Manrope) thành chữ trên banner.
avoid: inventing a second gold or warm-neutral palette that fights the format lock
personas.technique_hints: Prefer restrained premium lighting and light elegant motifs on the locked campaign color. Avoid cute stickers, bargain-sale decoration, and a photoreal beige interior that leaves the dominant mint/green.

personas.summary_vi: Ưu tiên sức khỏe, an toàn, sự bình yên — gym/yoga, sống chậm, bảo vệ số và bảo hiểm.
personas.scene: Serene wellness or protected-home moment — morning light, yoga/gym edge, calm living space, or a quiet 'peace of mind' digital-safety beat. Not a hospital. Product is the protector/enabler.
personas.talent: Vietnamese adult 28–45, clean athletic-leisure or simple home clothes, relaxed genuine calm, one person.
merchants_or_props: soft home interior — never a clinical hospital
personas.copy_tone: An tâm, trong trẻo — không dọa nạt, không medical gore, không 'virus' hình ảnh.
avoid: drawing threat graphics as extra copy
personas.technique_hints: Prefer airy light, soft gradients, calm spatial depth. Avoid aggressive red-alert decoration, skull/lock-spam motifs, and dense festive clutter.
